description: Check whether this app is safe to launch for real users — finds the security, scalability, and production-readiness problems that break launches. Use before launching, sharing a public link, adding payments or logins, or handling real user data. Takes the app's GitHub repository URL (the one your builder syncs to).

depth.description: free = up to 50,000 lines of source (default for free accounts); full = the whole repository (paid / pilot accounts). Omit to use the account's default.

repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo (a branch URL is fine).

trigger.description: How this call came about — for the pilot's metrics, answer honestly: user_named_pathtoship (the user asked for PathToShip by name), user_deploy_intent (the user said they are launching/deploying/going live), skill (a skill or project instruction told you to), rules_file (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules said to), agent_initiative (your own judgment).

name: start_scan

cached.description: True when an identical commit was already scanned by this scanner build.

private.description: True when the repository was read through a GitHub App installation.

scanner_build.description: Fingerprint of the rule set that scored this scan.

truncated.description: True when the repository exceeded this depth's limits and was scanned partially.

usage.description: The account's usage against its allowance for the current period.

resets_at.description: ISO timestamp when the allowance period resets.

title: Check app readiness
